Invariant-Driven Architecture

An invariant is a predicate that must remain true at all observable states of the system.

pub struct Account {
    balance: u64,
}

impl Account {
    pub fn debit(&mut self, amount: u64) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
        if self.balance < amount {
            return Err("invariant violated: balance underflow");
        }
        self.balance -= amount;
        Ok(())
    }
}
  • State boundaries enforce total validation.
  • Failure paths fail-closed without side effects.
